# `aitbc wallet multisig-sign`

Sign a pending multi-signature transaction with the given signer address.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc wallet multisig-sign [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--wallet` | text | — | yes | Multisig wallet name |
| `--tx-id` | text | — | yes | Transaction ID. |
| `--signer` | text | — | yes | Signer address |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc wallet multisig-sign --wallet <wallet_name> --tx-id <tx_id> --signer <signer>
```
